items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: See, most of the time we didn't have but three saxes in the band. Lester Young, Theodore Ross and myself.

ctx.x: Because that's a real stiff reed, isn't it.
Yeah, a stiff reed. See, most of the time we didn't have but three saxes in the band. Lester Young, Theodore Ross and myself.
So two altos and a tenor.
